title: EventEnvelope
description: Binding envelope for every domain event on the platform's Kafka/Redpanda bus. See docs/architecture/14-event-queue-architecture.md.

event_id.description: ULID, unique per publication (redeliveries reuse the same value).

event_type.description: PascalCase event type name, from contracts/events/registry.md.

event_version.description: Increments on a breaking payload change to this specific event_type.

producer.description: Deployable name that published the event, e.g. core-api.

occurred_at.description: Event-time (when the business fact became true), RFC3339 UTC.

published_at.description: Processing-time (when actually published to the bus), RFC3339 UTC.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope schema itself.
